capture.method: The kernel renders this document from the declared ChoiceSets of its own reference composition (kit/entity/present); the copy is the file at the named commit, byte for byte. It is the only capture in this repository that carries a resolved finite choice. Cases this capture does not carry - a single-answer choice, a malformed word - are built from its bytes in the test that needs them, the way every other catalogue case here is built.
capture.result: 4 entries, one field each, one answer set each: the same question drawn tiles, chips, swatch and figure.
capture.scope: A declared choice with many answers, a maximum of two that replaces the oldest, an empty policy that refuses, a No preference answer and colour artwork per answer. It carries no single-answer choice, which is why the phone declares one beside it.
